hello.description: Salute: Raise flat hand to forehead and move it outward.

thank_you.description: Flat hand touches lips/chin, then moves down and forward.

please.description: Flat hand rubs in a circle on the chest.

sorry.description: Fist rubs in a circle on the chest.

yes.description: Fist nods up and down at the wrist.

no.description: Index and middle fingers tap down onto the thumb.

iloveyou.description: Extend thumb, index, and pinky fingers (horn sign).

want.description: hold both your hands just above your chest and do a motion outwards....

father.description: hold your arm upwards towards your head...

mother.description: same as father but hand is placed between the nose and the upper lip

family.description: the middle finger touch and move backwards unti the wrists touch.

peace.description: hold letter v from the mouth and move it towards your chest
